idea: Letters & first words #1 – Letter A (SUNNY PARK picnic): a big chunky red foam letter A pops out of Baby Jimmy's picnic basket ('Wow! Look! A big letter A!'); A says a-a-a (say it with me) and 'Draw an A with me: up, down, across!' (copy-me); A is for apple – Jimmy lifts a shiny red apple; A is for ant – a cute little cartoon ant dances on his palm; review 'A! Apple! Ant!' with claps; he asks the viewer 'What does A say? Hmm?' (pause) – 'A says a, a, a! Yay!'; lesson 'A is for apple and ant!'. Loop: the hook framing again, A, apple and ant in a neat row, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Big Letter A! 🍎 A Is for Apple & Ant | Learn ABC with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big red letter A pops out of Baby Jimmy's picnic basket at Sunny Park! 🍎 Sing along and learn the letter A, its sound and two A words with Jimmy: apple and ant!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A big letter A!"
🗣️ A says a, a, a – say it with me!
✍️ Draw an A in the air with Jimmy: up, down, across!
🍎 A is for apple!
🐜 A is for ant – a tiny friendly ant says hello!
🤔 "What does A say?" – can you answer?
👋 A is for apple and ant! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: the letter A • the "a" sound • English words: apple, ant

A fun sing-along alphabet cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about the letter A, its phonics sound and first words, with Baby Jimmy at a picnic in the park.

Kids cartoon • ABC song • Phonics for kids • Alphabet for toddlers • Nursery rhymes • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning
